job_description:
Salary:
ABOUT YOU

Technical skills:

• HTTP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript(JS) with version ES6 or ES7 required
• JS package manager; Webpack preferred
• JS framework; React.js preferred
• Server side programming; Go or Node.js preferred
• Github and JIRA preferred
• Unix/Linux preferred
• Other programming language(s) experience, a plus

Hands on skills (required and must demonstrate):

• Develop and deploy web components
• Demonstrate the ability to write JS classes and functions without Googling

Other requirements:

• Know, understand, and practice the professional code of ethics
• Capable of learning new technologies independently
• Self starter
• Work with others with open mind
• College degree preferred but not required

• U.S Citizen

What You Will be Doing:

Work independently and with other programmers to develop front-end web applications using React.js, one of the most popular and in demand technologies. Wiling and capable of expanding one's horizon and skillset to include full stack development, including server side programming with node.js and/or Go. Able to learn and work with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, and Vagrant.

ABOUT US

We provide consulting and programming services to the customers in the healthcare IT domain. We are looking for an industrious person that will participate in various in-house IT projects. Work location is at our office in Columbia, MD.

Additional Info:

To apply please include a cover letter.Applications WITHOUT a cover letter will be auto rejected and NOT considered.

Benefits offered:

• 3 weeks paid time off annually
• 11 paid Federal Holidays annually
• Vanguard 401k with safe harbor company contribution
• Fully covered medical health insurance for the employee, with shared coverage for dependents
• Option for employee to add vision and dental
• Twice a week catered meals
